tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Full-Stack E-Commerce & Webshop Development
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Developer with 5+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms for global brands. Expert in Java, Spring, and RESTful API integration, with a strong background in optimizing webshop performance, usability, and backend-to-frontend data flows. Proven track record in techno-functional roles, bridging business requirements with technical implementation. Experienced in managing complex online infrastructures, coordinating with international stakeholders, and utilizing modern development workflows including Git, Jira, and CI/CD pipelines to deliver high-performance, scalable web applications.

cover_en.subject: Application: FULL-STACK-DEVELOPER FÜR E-COMMERCE & WEBSHOP (M/W/D)
cover_en.hook: I am impressed by VON LUPIN Cosmetic’s commitment to high-performance, medical-grade skincare and your focus on sustainable, partner-oriented growth. With over 5 years of experience as a backend and e-commerce developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute my expertise in building and scaling robust webshop infrastructures to your team.

bullets.label: Webshop Development
bullets.text: I have extensive experience designing and maintaining large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud platforms, ensuring high availability and performance for international e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: I specialize in designing and exposing RESTful APIs and OCC web services, facilitating seamless data exchange between PIM, ERP, and storefront systems.

bullets.label: Performance & Usability
bullets.text: I have led database query refactoring and storefront optimizations, directly improving transaction speeds and user experience for complex web applications.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: I bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution, translating stakeholder needs into functional specifications and high-quality code.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period, with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background can support your growth.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als FULL-STACK-DEVELOPER FÜR E-COMMERCE & WEBSHOP (M/W/D)
cover_de.hook: Die medizinisch fundierte Wirkstoffkosmetik von VON LUPIN und Ihr Fokus auf nachhaltigen Erfolg haben mich sofort angesprochen. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Expertise in der Skalierung von Webshops und der Optimierung von Online-Infrastrukturen mit.

bullets.label: Webshop-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich verfüge über umfassende Erfahrung in der Konzeption und operativen Weiterentwicklung von Enterprise-Webshops, wobei ich stets auf Performance und Stabilität achte.

bullets.label: Schnittstellen-Design
bullets.text: Die Entwicklung und Anbindung von REST-Schnittstellen zur Synchronisation von PIM- und ERP-Systemen gehört zu meinen Kernkompetenzen.

bullets.label: Performance-Optimierung
bullets.text: Durch gezieltes Datenbank-Refactoring und die Optimierung von Web-Applikationen habe ich die Antwortzeiten und die Usability für internationale Nutzer signifikant verbessert.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Ich agiere als Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT, übersetze Anforderungen in technische Spezifikationen und begleite den gesamten Entwicklungsprozess.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und besitze eine unbefristete Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 für eine neue Herausforderung zur Verfügung stehe. Gerne stelle ich mich Ihnen in einem persönlichen Gespräch vor.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to VON LUPIN Cosmetic because of your clear mission to combine medical-grade efficacy with a partner-centric business model. Your emphasis on 'Made in Germany' quality and sustainable, long-term growth resonates with my professional values. I am excited by the opportunity to apply my experience in scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms to help your brand continue its successful trajectory and enhance the digital experience for your partners and customers.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by building high-performance, scalable e-commerce solutions that directly impact business success. I enjoy the challenge of complex integrations and the opportunity to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where technical innovation meets user-centric design.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Commerce Developer with 5+ years of experience in enterprise e-commerce. I am very interested in the Full-Stack Developer role at VON LUPIN. I have submitted my application and would love to discuss how my background fits your team's needs.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application for the Full-Stack-Developer position at VON LUPIN Cosmetic. With over 5 years of experience in building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms, I am confident that my technical background in Java, REST APIs, and system integration will be a strong asset to your team. I am available to start on 16 December 2026 and look forward to the possibility of an interview.

Best regards,

Kranti Chavan
